customManagers.description: Update the release pins of the server bootstrap together with the sha256 of the release asset pinned beside each. The release is looked up by tag, so a tool whose tag differs from its version pins the full tag.
Update the bats-core version the server bootstrap pins. bats-core publishes no release assets, so its sha256 is refreshed by scripts/update_bats_checksum.sh in the same PR.

packageRules.description: The bats-core hash is not updated by Renovate, so a person must run the script before merging.
prBodyNotes: Run `scripts/update_bats_checksum.sh` and commit the new `BATS_SHA256` before merging: Renovate cannot hash the bats-core source archive, and a stale hash makes `scripts/bootstrap_server.sh` stop with `checksum mismatch`.
